description.value: Indian Curry Corner is a family-owned North Indian restaurant on Victoria Drive with over 25 years of culinary experience behind its kitchen. The menu spans a wide range of curries, tandoori items, biryanis, breads, and appetizers, with a notably deep vegetarian selection including paneer dishes and plant-based options. The restaurant also offers catering and in-store food pickup, making it a practical stop for a sit-down meal or grab-and-go order.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is live and corroborates the OSM address (6956 Victoria Drive, Vancouver) and provides a phone number (778-737-8008) absent from OSM. The site confirms active online ordering/takeout and an extensive vegetarian menu (19 Veg Curries, 8 Paneer Curries, catering page explicitly lists 'Vegan, Jain' options). No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides 778-737-8008 — added from website.

About Us page staff bios (Davis Clark, Lenora Flores, John Bowers, Sarah Seymour) contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text, suggesting the website template was not fully customized. Core business content appears authentic regardless.
About Us page states 'Our Restaurant has been present for over 3 years in the market' but blog posts date only to January 2026, making the 3-year claim unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate, active food stop with good vegetarian options and takeout, but none of the three WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website. An on-site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes 19 Veg Curries, 8 Paneer Curries, and plant-based dishes (e.g. Soya Makhani, Soya Chaap Masala); catering page explicitly lists 'Vegan, Jain' as custom menu options

wow_evidence: family-owned North Indian restaurant on Victoria Drive with over 25 years of culinary experience
